name: agent-bar
title: Agent bar
description: The voice-first bar for an agent that works in the background: a pill with a history arrow, the field, a mic (tap to listen, hold to talk and release to send) and send, an optional quoted-row chip, AgentStatus, the one-line spinner or check above it, and the question card the agent asks above the bar (`question`: choices with one preselected, answered by a tap or from the bar). `useAgentBarChat(controller, { actions })` drives the bar, the question and the status from the chat controller PiChat takes. Dictation and the hold gesture are the kit's; the app supplies `transcribe` (or a live `stream`, which shows the words as they come) and `onSend`. Optional `attachments` (drop on the bar, paste, a pick button, the same chips as PiChat) and `slash` (typing / or an Actions button opens the commands list), both off by default.
